name: Sundern (Sauerland, Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, blue and white in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the top with the city arms of Sundern (a saint on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Sundern; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
